finding: Generated scheduling does not interleave dequant arithmetic with WMMA across the cooperative handoff: the static decode region between the two workgroup barriers contains zero WMMA. Sixteen separated groups of 12 WMMA instructions consume the K16 groups outside that region.
exact_candidate: Decode adjacent column pairs per work item. The qmicro format shares each low-byte record across a column pair and each high byte across a four-column quartet; current per-column decode repeats those record-byte loads and address/unpack work. Pair decoding preserves each output weight and WMMA accumulation order while retaining all four cooperative waves and the 16 KiB LDS layout.
decision: Dedicated-wave overlap is rejected, and same-wave overlap cannot cross the generated barriers. Screen exact pair-column cooperative decode next; do not attempt another producer-wave geometry.
